coverage: Connected socket receives event before disconnect; no fallback before 30 seconds.
Disconnected controller polls at 30 seconds, fetches missed message, and survives an optional failed first poll.
Reconnect reloads history; new/duplicate events after reconnect merge without loss or duplication.
While connected, 60 seconds cause no fallback HTTP; second disconnect resumes polling and dispose cancels timers.
limitations: Real controller with controlled socket transitions, HTTP fixture and Flutter virtual clock; no physical radio/network outage or real TCP reconnect claim.
Two interleaving variants (first poll succeeds/fails), not latency or availability statistics.
